title: Spanish café: greet and order politely

turns.message: Give me a challenge on this.
I'll guess: café takes una because the English word 'coffee' feels feminine.
I’m stuck; which phrase softens an order for a stranger?
Give me another challenge on this.
Correct answer: café is masculine, so use un café; me gustaría or querría makes the request softer.
Mi respuesta: Me gustaría un café, por favor.
/verify Buenos días is the standard general morning greeting in Spanish.

expectations.notes: Keep the café dialogue at A1 level and preserve accents when practical; correct article gender from Spanish rather than the English gloss; accept the learner’s Spanish answer after checking the polite-request pattern.
